iti111:2.1: bhikkhave viharatha, sampannapātimokkha pātimokkhāsaṃvarasaṃvutā viharatha, ācāragocarasampannā anumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhatha sikkhāpadesu.
iti111:3.1: -Sampannasīlānaṃ bhikkhave viharataṃ, sampannapātimokkhānaṃ pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvutānaṃ vihārataṃ, ācāragocarasampannānaṃ anumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvīnaṃ samādāya sikkhataṃ sikkhāpadesu kiñcassa bhikkhave uttari karaṇīyaṃ? --
iti111:4.1: Carato ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhuno abhijjhā vigatā hoti, vyāpādo vigato hoti, thīnamiddhaṃ vigataṃ hoti, uddhaccakukkuccaṃ vigataṃ hoti, vicikicchā pahīnā hoti, āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asaṃmuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ,
iti111:4.2: caraṃ pi bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃbhūto ātāpī ottappī satataṃ samitaṃ āraddhaviriyo pahitatto ti vuccati. --
iti111:5.1: Ṭhitassa ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhuno abhijjhā vigatā hoti, vyāpādo vigato hoti, thīnamiddhaṃ vigataṃ hoti, uddhaccakukkuccaṃ vigataṃ hoti, vicikicchā pahīnā hoti, āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asaṃmuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ,
iti111:5.2: ṭhito pi bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃbhūto ātāpī ottappī satataṃ samitaṃ āraddhaviriyo pahitatto ti vuccati. --
iti111:6.1: Nisinnassa ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhuno abhijjhā vigatā hoti, vyāpādo vigato hoti, thīnamiddhaṃ vigataṃ hoti, uddhaccakukkuccaṃ vigataṃ hoti, vicikicchā pahīnā hoti, āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asaṃmuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ,
iti111:6.2: nisinno pi bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃbhūto ātāpī ottappī satataṃ samitaṃ āraddhaviriyo pahitatto ti vuccati. --
iti111:7.1: Sayānassa ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhuno jāgarassa abhijjhā vigatā hoti, vyāpādo vigato hoti, thīnamiddhaṃ vigataṃ hoti, uddhaccakukkuccaṃ vigataṃ hoti, vicikicchā pahīnā hoti, āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asaṃmuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ,
iti111:7.2: sayāno pi bhikkhave bhikkhu jāgaro evaṃbhūto ātāpī ottappī satataṃ samitaṃ āraddhaviriyo pahitatto ti vuccatīti.
